openwrt_wiki.Hinweis: The TP-Link Archer C2 AC750 is similar to C20i, but has a Gigabit switch instead of the 100M switch in the C20i.
openwrt_wiki.Installation OEM GUI: Flashing from the latest TP-Link firmware (Build 151014) via the web interface seems to brick the device. Download and flash an older OEM firmware first (Build 140709) before you continue.
openwrt_wiki.TFTP: Recovery image without 512-byte header (dd bs=512 skip=1), name ArcherC20iV1_tp_recovery.bin, TFTP server 192.168.0.66, connect to LAN port, press WPS/Reset and power up
openwrt_wiki.Recovery: Hold the WPS button during startup. After 10 seconds the router will start trying to download ArcherC20iV1_tp_recovery.bin via tftp from 192.168.0.66 for 10 more seconds.
openwrt_wiki.Serial Port: Serial console is available on the J2 connector, 3.3v signals. The square pad (pin 1) is Vcc and hence unused, pin 2 is Gnd and the remaining two pins are Rx and Tx. The picture below shows the serial port brought out to an external connector. Factory software console login admin / 1234
openwrt_wiki.Switch Ports Hinweis: LAN port numbering does not follow the internal switch numbering order (3/4/1/2 -> 1/2/3/4)
openwrt_wiki.Benchmarks: 2.4GHz N WPA2: about 70-100Mbit/s to a MacBook Air close to the router
openwrt_wiki.Flash Layout Hinweis: Flash is identified as SPI 64 Mbit Macronix MX25L6405D but the bootlog says "found mx25l6405d, expected en25q64" suggesting that different chips may be present in different hardware batches
openwrt_wiki.OpenWrt Flash Layout: mtd0 u-boot 0x20000; mtd1 firmware 0x7a0000; mtd2 kernel 0x140000; mtd3 rootfs 0x660000; mtd4 rootfs_data 0x430000; mtd5 config 0x10000; mtd6 rom 0x10000; mtd7 romfile 0x10000; mtd8 radio 0x10000
openwrt_wiki.U-Boot: 1.1.3 (Jun 23 2014 - 15:14:15), Ralink UBoot Version 4.1.2.0; autoboot ohne Prompt-Verzögerung, Menüpunkte 4 (CLI, getestet), 7, 0, 5
openwrt_wiki.OEM-Bootlog: Archer C20i v1.0.0; spi device id c2 20 17 (MX25L6405D); DRAM component 512 Mbits DDR, width 16; Total memory 64 MBytes; CPU 580 MHz; Linux 2.6.36; console=ttyS1,115200; Treiber rt2860v2_ap (2.4 GHz) und MT7610_ap (5 GHz)
